app.title: Clarify - JSON file management system
tooltip.path: Enter the directory path or file path to search in
tooltip.browse: Open file browser to select a directory or file
tooltip.is_file: Check this if you want to process a single file instead of a directory
tooltip.extensions: Filter files by extensions. Examples:\n  .py,.js,.tsx\n  py,js,tsx
tooltip.sort_results: Sort file paths and results in alphabetical order
tooltip.include:
Advanced glob patterns to include specific files.
Examples:
  *.test.*    - Test files
  **/src/**   - Files in src folders
tooltip.exclude: Glob patterns to exclude folders/files.\nDefault excludes common build/dependency folders
tooltip.query: Enter the text pattern to search for in files\nResizable: drag bottom edge to adjust height
tooltip.whole_word: Match only complete words (not partial matches)
tooltip.regex: Treat query as a regular expression pattern
tooltip.multi_query: Enable multi-line query mode:\n- Line 1: main query\n- Lines 2+: OR alternatives
tooltip.search_button: Start search operation or cancel if already running
tooltip.replacement: Enter the replacement text (supports regex capture groups like $1, $2)\nResizable: drag bottom edge to adjust height
tooltip.preserve_case: Maintain the original case pattern when replacing
tooltip.replace_one: Replace only the first occurrence in each file
tooltip.replace_all: Replace all occurrences in all matching files
tooltip.logic_op: AND: All conditions must match\nOR: At least one condition must match
tooltip.add_condition: Add a new condition row (no maximum limit)
tooltip.save_results: Save all search results to a formatted text file with statistics
shortcuts.dialog.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.dialog.os_warning_message:
This shortcut may conflict with your operating system shortcuts.

Do you want to use it anyway?
tooltip.set_ops.file_a: First JSON file for comparison operations (intersection, union, difference)
tooltip.set_ops.file_b: Second JSON file for comparison operations
tooltip.set_ops.chk_multiple: Enable to add more files for sequential operations
tooltip.set_ops.btn_add_file: Add more files to pipeline (operations applied sequentially left to right)
tooltip.set_ops.intersection: ∩ Intersection: Find items present in ALL files (A ∩ B ∩ C...)
tooltip.set_ops.union: ∪ Union: Combine all unique items from ALL files (A ∪ B ∪ C...)
tooltip.set_ops.difference: − Difference: Items in first file NOT in others (A - B - C...)
tooltip.set_ops.symmetric: ⊕ Symmetric Difference: Items in A or B but NOT in both (A ⊕ B). Works with 2 files only.
tooltip.set_ops.radio_key_value: Compare keys + values with strict type checking (e.g., 1 ≠ '1', true ≠ 'true')
tooltip.set_ops.radio_full_path: Compare full paths + values using dot notation (e.g., 'user.name' vs 'name')
tooltip.set_ops.radio_key_only: Compare only key paths, ignore values (useful for structure comparison)
tooltip.set_ops.skip_empty: Ignore null, empty strings (''), empty arrays ([]), and empty objects ({})
tooltip.set_ops.combo_output: JSON nested: single file with all results | Separate files: one file per operation | Display only: show in Results panel without saving
tooltip.set_ops.btn_execute: Execute selected set operations on provided JSON files
tooltip.case.combo_source: Original case style of your code (auto-detect recommended)
tooltip.case.combo_target: Desired case style for conversion (e.g., snake_case for Python)
tooltip.case.ed_path: Path to file or directory containing code to convert (supports .js, .ts, .jsx, .tsx, .py)
tooltip.case.chk_is_file: Check if path is a file (unchecked for directory)
tooltip.case.ed_extensions: File extensions to process (comma-separated, e.g., .js,.ts,.py). Leave empty for all files.
